site.meta.title: Lewydo™ — Love What You Do · isitudiyo semidlalo esizimele sase-Ukraine
site.meta.desc: I-Lewydo yisitudiyo semidlalo esizimele sabantu ababili sase-Ukraine. U-Vlad ubhala ikhodi, u-Lilya uyaklama. Dlala i-CubePix ne-Orbit Dash lapha ekhasini, futhi uthole yonke imidlalo yethu ku-Google Play.
site.nav.label: Imenyu enkulu
site.lang.title: Ulimi
site.hero.lead: Singo-Vlad no-Lilya. **U-Vlad ubhala ikhodi, u-Lilya uyaklama** — futhi ndawonye senza imidlalo esithanda ukuyidlala nathi.
site.hero.replay: Inhliziyo ye-Lewydo. Thepha ukuze uyakhe kabusha
site.worlds.title: Umdlalo ngamunye ungumhlaba wawo
site.worlds.lead: Ngena udlale khona lapha: ikhasi liyashintsha nomhlaba ngamunye.
site.cp.next: Ukuthandile? Imnyuziyamu yonke yemidwebo ikulindile ku-demo yamahhala.
site.cp.aria: Iphazili encane ye-CubePix: gcwalisa amaseli ngenombolo yekhyubhu yakho
site.od.tag: Imizila emibili. Ukuthepha okukodwa. Konke ukugxuma kusesigqini.
site.od.lead: Umdlalo wesigqi emkhathini ojulile: ukuthepha okukodwa kushintsha umzila, futhi konke ukugxuma kuwela esigqini somculo wethu. Amazinga amahlanu, imodi engapheli, i-Orbit III kanye nebhodi labaholi lomhlaba.
site.od.new: Manje **ngezilimi ezingu-82**. Umdlalo uzikhethela ngokwawo ulimi lwefoni yakho. Lushintshe noma nini ngembulunga kuzilungiselelo.
site.more.title: Okwengeziwe kwa-Lewydo
site.more.lead: Iphazili ezolile yokuhlanganisa, i-clicker enethezekile kanye neziqondiso ezisebenzisanayo zabathuthukisi bemidlalo — konke ku-Google Play.
site.game.imc.d: Hudula. Hlanganisa. Khula. Iphazili ezolile ye-idle yokuhlanganisa enemigomo, imiklomelo yansuku zonke nokuqhubeka kwamakhyubhu okungapheli.
site.game.joints.d: Isiqondiso esisebenzisanayo sama-joint e-Box2D ku-LibGDX, esinezibonelo eziphilayo, opopayi nezixhumanisi eziwusizo. Senziwe ngumthuthukisi we-LibGDX sabathuthukisi be-LibGDX.
site.game.light.d: Dlala nezinhlobo ezine zokukhanya kwe-2D: iphoyinti, ikhoni, uchungechunge nokuqondile. Hambisa amalambu, wenze izithunzi futhi ulungise yonke into.
site.game.autumn.d: I-clicker yasekwindla enamaqabunga awayo, imibala efudumele, imisindo yemvelo ongayivula namabhodi abaholi. Asikho isikhathi, ayikho ingcindezi: vele uthephe uphumule.
site.studio.title: Abantu ababili, inhliziyo eyodwa
site.cd.title: U-Vlad ubhala ikhodi. U-Lilya uyaklama.
site.cd.text: Hudula isilayida: yile ndlela umdlalo ngamunye we-Lewydo uzalwa ngayo, kusukela kukhodi ka-Vlad kuya kumklamo ka-Lilya.
site.brand.more: Uphawu lwe-Lewydo: inhliziyo, ukushaya kwayo nephakethe
site.p.vlad.who: U-Vlad, umthuthukisi we-Android ne-LibGDX · isifunda sasePoltava, e-Ukraine
site.p.vlad.bio: Ubhala ikhodi kusukela ngo-2017: kuqala i-Java, ngemva konyaka i-Kotlin. Ungumthuthukisi wemidlalo wesikhathi esigcwele kusukela ngo-2021, kusukela kumfundi ofundela umsebenzi kuya ku-Team Lead esitudiyo semidlalo. Wonke umdlalo we-Lewydo wakhiwe nge-Kotlin ne-LibGDX, kuqala ku-Android.
site.p.lilya.bio: Amawebhusayithi, ukuklama izethulo nezithombe zezinkundla zokuxhumana kungumsebenzi wakhe omkhulu. Ngenxa ka-Vlad wangena nasekuklameni imidlalo, futhi wonke umdlalo we-Lewydo unesandla sakhe. *Phakathi kwethu: amawebhusayithi asewuthando lwakhe lokuqala* 😉
site.story.title: Indaba yethu kuze kube manje
site.story.1.d: U-Vlad ubhala ikhodi yakhe yokuqala. Ngemva konyaka uya ku-Kotlin futhi uhlala kuyo unomphela.
site.story.2.d: U-Vlad ushiya i-Military Institute of Telecommunications angene emidlalweni isikhathi esigcwele: umfundi ofundela umsebenzi, i-junior… kuze kube yi-Team Lead.
site.story.3.d: Umthuthukisi uhlangana nomklami. Isitudiyo asikazi ukuthi sikhona.
site.story.4.d: Usuku olufanayo, inyanga ehlukile — iqembu unomphela.
site.story.brand.d: U-Vlad wayehlala eqeda izindatshana zakhe ze-[Medium](https://veldan1202.medium.com/) mayelana ne-LibGDX, i-Android ne-Kotlin ngendlela efanayo: «Love what you do» nenhliziyo eluhlaza 💚. Lelo sayini laba uphawu lwethu.
site.story.imc.d: I-IMC: Idle Merge Cubes 2026 iphuma ku-Google Play.
site.story.idea.d: U-Vlad usebenza Emabuthweni Ahlomile ase-Ukraine. Ngolunye usuku ekuseni uvuka endlini lapho iyunithi yakhe ihlala khona ngesikhathi somsebenzi — enomqondo we-CubePix ekhanda.
site.story.od.d: Senza i-Orbit Dash futhi siyikhiphe ku-Google Play: imizila emibili, ukuthepha okukodwa.
site.story.proto.d: I-prototype yokuqala engadlalwa: imidwebo edumile yembulwa ikhyubhu ngekhyubhu.
site.story.pix.d: Siklama i-mascot ye-CubePix: ikhyubhu encane ebomvana, umdwebi onesigqoko se-beret nebhulashi. Igama lakhe ngu-Pix — Cube + Pix = CubePix, ngakho umdlalo uthwele igama lakhe.
site.story.live.d: U-Andrii (TikTok @malcev_ua) udlala i-Orbit Dash ku-TikTok LIVE — i-streamer yokuqala ukusakaza bukhoma nomdlalo wethu.
site.story.live.video: U-Andrii udlala i-Orbit Dash bukhoma ku-TikTok
site.story.live.thanks: Ngiyabonga, Andrii, ngokuba yi-streamer yami yokuqala esakaze bukhoma idlala umdlalo wami. Ngiyabonga kakhulu!
site.story.next.d: Iyeza kule nyanga — usuku oluqondile maduze.
site.contact.title: Masenze into ozoyithanda
site.contact.text: Unomqondo wokusebenzisana okuthakazelisayo, noma udinga umdlalo wekhwalithi ephezulu? Sibhalele — singajabula kakhulu ukuzwa kuwe.
site.nf.title: Leli khasi lilahlekile
site.nf.text: Kungenzeka ukuthi lisusiwe, noma kunephutha lokubhala esixhumanisini. Konke esikwenzayo kusekhasini lasekhaya.
site.music.label: Ingoma ethandwa ngu-Vlad: sombr — 12 to 12
site.od.levels: Lona ngumdlalo wangempela. Thepha isikrini udlale izinga ngokwakho.

brand.meta.desc: Indlela yokubona i-Lewydo, nakho konke umdlalo we-Lewydo okudingayo ukuze uyibonise ngendlela efanayo: ilogo, imibala, isikrini sokuqala, isayini yemenyu, Ngathi nokushaya kwenhliziyo — namafayela nekhodi.
brand.nav.label: Ikhasi lophawu
brand.hero.title: Inhliziyo eyodwa, iyafana yonke indawo
brand.hero.sub: Indlela yokubona i-Lewydo — nakho konke umdlalo we-Lewydo okudingayo ukuze uyibonise ngendlela efanayo: ilogo, imibala yayo, isikrini sokuqala, isayini yemenyu, Ngathi nokushaya kwenhliziyo. Izithombe nekhodi zikhona lapha, zikhululekile ukusetshenziswa kumaphrojekthi e-Lewydo.
brand.rec.title: Indlela yokubona i-Lewydo
brand.rec.sub: Inhliziyo eluhlaza edwetshwe ngesandla emise okwebhamuza lokukhuluma, ekhazimula ngombala we-mint phezu kweluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka olujulile lobusuku, negama elimhlophe eliyindilinga ngaphansi kwayo. Noma kuphi lapho uyibona khona, lowo mdlalo siwenze sobabili, ngothando.
brand.part.heart.d: Idwetshwe ngesandla, imise okwebhamuza lokukhuluma: uyinki omnyama, ukugcwalisa okuluhlaza okunokuthungwa kwetshoki, amachaphaza ambalwa.
brand.part.glow.d: Ukukhazimula okuthambile kwe-mint (#6DF593) kuzungeze inhliziyo — kuyingxenye yelogo, akusoze kwaba ngumphumela owodwa.
brand.part.slogan.d: «Love What You Do» — njalo ngesiNgisi, luwuphawu lokuhweba. Izinhlamvu zalo ezigqamile zakha igama.
brand.part.line.d: Umugqa omncane omhlophe, ububanzi obungu-146, ovala ilogo.
brand.spell: Igama livela esiqubulweni: izinhlamvu ezigqamile ze-«Love What You Do» zifundeka **Lewydo**. Yingakho isiqubulo singahunyushwa neze.
brand.where.1.d: Isikrini sokuqala: i-Lockup iyavela, inhliziyo ishaya kanye.
brand.where.2.d: Iphilisi lesayini — lithephe ukuze wazi isitudiyo.
brand.where.3.d: I-Lockup ngaphezu kwamagama ambalwa ngathi sobabili.

brand.dev.title: Faka i-Lewydo emdlalweni omusha
brand.dev.sub: Konke okungezansi kuku-[repository yewebhusayithi → brand/](https://github.com/RoShevasternin/roshevasternin.github.io/tree/main/brand) naku-[brand.json](/brand/brand.json) (zonke izinombolo, imibhalo ngazo zonke izilimi zemidlalo yethu nezindlela zamafayela — zekhodi nezika-Claude).
brand.step.1.d: Kopisha `kit/atlas/brand.atlas` + `brand.png` uye ku-`assets/atlas/` kanye ne-`kit/sound/lewydo-heartbeat.wav` uye ku-`assets/sound/`; izifunda ze-atlas: `brand_back`, `brand_front`, `lewydo`, `slogan`, `brand_line` (i-`assetsBrand` yakho, `EnumAtlas.BRAND`).
brand.step.2.d: Kopisha i-`LewydoHeartbeat.kt` (iphakheji `com.lewydo.brand`) ne-`BrandScreen.kt`, `ABrandGroup.kt`, `ABrandLogo.kt`; shintsha i-`yourgame` ibe yiphakheji yakho. Zisebenzisa isisekelo se-LibGDX se-Lewydo (AdvancedScreen, AConstraintLayout, AAutoLayout).
brand.step.3.d: Qala umdlalo ku-`BrandScreen`: ≈ 4 s — ilogo iyafika, ukushaya kwenhliziyo nomsindo we-Lewydo, bese kuba yi-`LoaderScreen`. Xhuma i-`soundVolume()` nevolumu yemisindo yomdlalo wakho: 1.0 ezingeni layo elijwayelekile, iphansi kuphela uma umdlali eyinciphisa.
brand.step.4.d: Iphilisi ngaphansi kwemenyu (maphakathi, 34 px ukusuka phansi) → Ngathi; ukushaya okukodwa uma imenyu ivela.
brand.step.5.d: I-Lockup phezulu ku-108, umbhalo wesitudiyo (isiNgisi yisibonelo; zonke izilimi zemidlalo yethu zisefayeleni le-brand.json), «Iwebhusayithi yethu» → `https://roshevasternin.github.io/` nekheli ngaphansi kwayo, «Imidlalo yethu ku-Google Play» → ikhasi lethu lomthuthukisi, «© 2026 Lewydo™». Ukushaya okukodwa njalo uma ivuleka.
brand.step.6.d: Lungisa ingemuva nokukhanya ngemuva kwelogo kuvumelane nomdlalo wakho — hhayi neze ilogo uqobo.
brand.prompt: Ka-Claude kwenye iphrojekthi — kopisha lokhu (u-Claude ukufunda ngesiNgisi)
brand.foot: © 2026 Lewydo™ · Love What You Do. Ilogo ye-Lewydo ingeyethu: yisebenzise kumaphrojekthi e-Lewydo kuphela, futhi kuphela njengoba leli phakethe libonisa.
brand.hb.finale: Esikrinini sokuqala ukushaya kwenhliziyo **kuyisiphetho**: kuqala kufika yonke ilogo, bese ukuphefumula, «dum» enamandla nenye «dum», amagagasi amabili okukhanya — nomsindo we-Lewydo.
brand.snd.title: Umsindo we-Lewydo
brand.snd.sub: Inhliziyo kuphela: ukushaya okubili okuthambile neyindilinga — okokuqala kunamandla, okwesibili kuthulile — ngesikhathi esifanayo nokushaya kwelogo. Ayikho iculo, akukho kukhala: ukubingelela okuthulile nokufudumele.
brand.snd.r1: Kanye ekuqaleni ngakunye, nesikrini sokuqala — hhayi neze ngokungapheli.
brand.snd.r2: Ngevolumu egcwele uma imisindo yomdlalo isezingeni elijwayelekile (ukukhulisa 1.0); isilayida somdlali singakwazi ukuyinciphisa kuphela; imisindo icishiwe — ukuthula.
brand.snd.r3: Ungalishintshi neze, ungalinqumi futhi ungalidlali ngaphansi komculo.
brand.snd.r4: Ikhasi lewebhu lingalidlala kuphela ngemva kokuthepha; isikrini sokuqala esizidlalela sona sihlala sithulile.
brand.snd.r5: Ifayela elilodwa yonke indawo: `lewydo-heartbeat.wav` — wonke umdlalo, i-prototype yawo yewebhu newebhusayithi yawo kudlala leli fayela kanye, i-byte ngo-byte. Alilahlekelwa yikhwalithi (16-bit PCM, 48 kHz, i-stereo) futhi lenzelwe izipikha zocingo (ama-overtone alo, iziqongo ku-−1 dBFS) — ukuze i-Lewydo izwakale ngendlela efanayo noma kuphi lapho uyizwa khona.
brand.say.note: «Lewydo» ngu-«Love What You Do» kushiwo ngokushesha: amalunga amathathu, **Lev-wai-du**.
brand.c.sound.d: Ukushaya kwenhliziyo — i-.wav eyodwa engalahlekelwa yikhwalithi yemidlalo, ama-prototype ewebhu namawebhusayithi. Awekho amakhophi e-.ogg noma e-.mp3: idivayisi ngayinye ibizowahumusha ngendlela ehluke kancane.
brand.dont.5: Ukudlala umsindo ngokungapheli, ngokuzwakala kakhulu kunomdlalo, noma lapho umdlali ecishe umsindo.
brand.work.title: Kuqala i-prototype, bese umdlalo
brand.work.lead: Yile ndlela umdlalo ngamunye we-Lewydo owenziwa ngayo.
brand.work.1: **Konke okusha kuqala ku-prototype.** Isikrini, indlela yokudlala, umbhalo noma inombolo kwenziwa futhi kuhlolwe kuqala ku-prototype yewebhu yomdlalo — kuyashesha ukuhlola kusiphequluli.
brand.work.2: **Umdlalo uthuthwa kuyo.** Umdlalo (LibGDX: Android, kamuva iOS) uthatha konke ku-prototype, izinombolo namagama kufana ncamashi: i-prototype iyisibonelo.
brand.work.3: **Hhayi neze ngokuphambene.** Into entsha eyenziwe ngaphakathi komdlalo kuphela, i-prototype ayiyazi, futhi kokubili kuyahlukana. Ngisho nokulungisa: kuqala ku-prototype, bese emdlalweni.

S.lead: Iphazili ezolile yabathandi bobuciko. Gcwalisa amakhyubhu ungqimba ngongqimba, futhi imidwebo edumile, izimangaliso zomhlaba nemicebo emincane yama-pixel kuyaphila. Isithombe ngasinye siphela ngelebula lemnyuziyamu nendaba yeqiniso.
S.about: I-Lewydo yisitudiyo esincane semidlalo sabantu ababili sase-Ukraine. U-Vlad ubhala ikhodi, u-Lilya uyaklama. Ndawonye senza imidlalo nathi esithanda ukuyidlala.
S.how: Ikhyubhu yakho ikhombisa inombolo. Thepha amaseli anenombolo efanayo, noma uswayiphe phezu kwawo ngochungechunge olulodwa olude: uchungechunge lunikeza amaphuzu amaningi.
S.pixName: Uyikhyubhu (cube), futhi igama lakhe ngu-Pix. Kuhlanganise uthole i-CubePix: umdlalo uthwele igama lakhe.

strawberry.f: Isitrobheli empeleni asiyona i-berry: «imbewu» ngayinye encane esikhumbeni saso iyisithelo esihlukile esinembewu ngaphakathi.
